import sys, os, ctypes, random
from fractions import Fraction
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/site','/workspace/submission']
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/native/libz.so.1',mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from offline_discovery.rule_generate import *
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import ValidationIndex
from online_matching.match_p4 import *
R=random.Random(512)
for trial in range(200):
    n=R.randint(1,70)
    seqs=[[R.choice([R.randrange(3029),0,3028,1513,1515]) for _ in range(R.randint(2,16))] for _ in range(n)]
    for s in seqs:
        while 1514 in s: s[s.index(1514)]=1515
    groups={len(s) for s in seqs}
    for length in groups:
        group=[s for s in seqs if len(s)==length]
        p,q=R.randint(0,5000),R.randint(1,20)
        matrix=neighbor_matrix(group,[p,q])
        for i,a in enumerate(group):
            for j,b in enumerate(group):
                S=sum((abs(a-b)+1000*(a<1514<b or b<1514<a))**2 for a,b in zip(a,b))
                A=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(a,b))
                expected=Fraction(S,length)*Fraction(9,25)**A <= Fraction(p,q)**2
                assert matrix[i,j]==expected, (a,b,p,q)
        ranges=generalized_range(group)
        for j in range(length):
            c=[s[j] for s in group]
            with localcontext() as ctx:
                ctx.prec=80
                avg=sum(map(Decimal,c))/len(c)
                sigma=(sum((Decimal(v)-avg)**2 for v in c)/len(c)).sqrt()
                expected=[max(0,int(min(c)-sigma)),min(3028,int(max(c)+sigma))]
                assert ranges[j]==expected, (ranges[j],expected,c)
print('distances and ranges ok')
for trial in range(100):
    classes=R.randint(1,6)
    rows=[]
    for i in range(R.randint(1,200)):
        n=R.randrange(129)
        v=[R.choice([0,3028,1513,1515,R.randrange(3029)]) for _ in range(n)]
        for j in range(len(v)):
            if v[j]==1514: v[j]=1513
        v += [1514]*R.randrange(129-n)
        rows.append({'values':v,'class':R.randrange(classes)})
    idx=ValidationIndex({'classes':classes,'validation':rows})
    for repeat in range(50):
        pattern=[]
        for i in range(R.randint(2,16)):
            lo,hi=sorted([R.randrange(3029),R.randrange(3029)])
            if R.random()<.3:lo,hi=0,3028
            pattern.append([lo,hi])
        expected=[0]*classes
        for row in rows:
            v=real_values(row['values'])
            if any(all(lo<=v[s+j]<=hi for j,(lo,hi) in enumerate(pattern)) for s in range(len(v)-len(pattern)+1)):
                expected[row['class']]+=1
        got=idx.hits(pattern)
        assert got==expected,(got,expected,pattern)
print('coverage ok')
for trial in range(300):
    pats=[]
    for cid in range(R.randint(0,50)):
        pat=[]
        for _ in range(R.randint(2,16)):
            lo,hi=sorted([R.randrange(3029),R.randrange(3029)])
            if R.random()<.4:lo,hi=0,3028
            pat.append([lo,hi])
        pats.append({'id':cid,'class':R.randrange(16),'range':pat})
    R.shuffle(pats)
    m=PatternClassifier(pats)
    values=[]; state=0
    for j in range(100):
        v=R.randrange(3029)
        if v==1514:v=1515
        values.append(v)
        state,got=m.step(state,v)
        expected=None
        for pat in pats:
            L=len(pat['range'])
            if len(values)>=L and all(lo<=x<=hi for x,(lo,hi) in zip(values[-L:],pat['range'])):
                expected=pat['id'],pat['class'],L
                break
        assert got==expected,(got,expected)
print('matcher ok')
for trial in range(300):
    pats=[]
    keys=set()
    for cid in range(R.randint(0,30)):
        pat=[]
        for _ in range(R.randint(2,5)):
            lo=R.randint(1510,1518); hi=lo+R.randint(0,3)
            pat.append([lo,hi])
        pats.append({'range':pat})
        keys.update(product(*(tuple(v for v in range(lo,hi+1) if v!=1514) for lo,hi in pat)))
    cap=R.randrange(100)
    assert exact_entries(pats,cap)==min(len(keys),cap+1)
print('exact tables ok')
